description: Supported versions of Linux and Windows Server, Docker, PostgreSQL and compatible DBMS (Postgres Pro, Jatoba, Tantor), Microsoft SQL Server, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch and Kubernetes tools for Directum RX, as summarized on drxinfra.ru from the vendor documents. The table covers RX 4.12 and RX 25.2 only; for other releases it says so instead of guessing. Optional filters by component and RX version.
